{
  "name": "deepseek-design-workspace",
  "private": true,
  "version": "1.0.0-beta.28",
  "type": "module",
  "workspaces": [
    "packages/studio-core",
    "packages/deepseek-design",
    "packages/deepseek-video",
    "packages/studio-core/src/original/ui",
    "packages/studio-core/src/original/types"
  ],
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=24.9.0"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "build": "node scripts/build.mjs",
    "typecheck": "tsc -p tsconfig.host.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.studio.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit",
    "test": "tsx --test tests/*.test.ts && node --test tests/*.test.mjs",
    "check": "npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check:boundaries && node scripts/check-package.mjs && node scripts/check-source.mjs",
    "pack:plugins": "node scripts/pack.mjs",
    "build:runtime": "node scripts/runtime-build.mjs",
    "prepare:models": "node scripts/prepare-video-models.mjs",
    "check:boundaries": "node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs",
    "test:browser": "node --test tests/browser/editor-state.spec.mjs"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@base-ui/react": "1.4.1",
    "@daypicker/react": "10.0.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/cordis": "4.1.0",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller": "0.2.2-rc.3",

    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store": "0.2.2-rc.3",

    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout": "0.2.2-rc.3",

    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-renderer": "0.2.2-rc.3",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-session": "0.2.2-rc.3",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings": "0.2.2-rc.3",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar": "0.2.2-rc.3",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right": "0.2.2-rc.3",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots": "0.2.2-rc.3",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace": "0.2.2-rc.3",

    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools": "0.2.2-rc.3",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-workspace": "0.2.2-rc.3",
    "@deepseek-ai/schemastery": "3.19.0",
    "@fontsource-variable/geist": "^5.2.6",
    "@fontsource-variable/ibm-plex-sans": "^5.2.5",
    "@huggingface/transformers": "^3.8.1",
    "@modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps": "1.7.5",

    "@shikijs/transformers": "^4.0.2",
    "@tailwindcss/node": "4.1.18",

    "oauth4webapi": "^3.8.7",

    "typescript": "^5.9.0",

    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm": "0.2.2-rc.3",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt": "0.2.2-rc.3",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-util-workspace-path": "0.2.2-rc.3",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-resources": "0.2.2-rc.3",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-workspace-files": "0.2.2-rc.3",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat": "0.2.2-rc.3",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-deliverables": "0.2.2-rc.3",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives": "0.2.2-rc.3"
  },
  "overrides": {
    "image-size": "2.1.0",
    "react": "$react",
    "react-dom": "$react-dom",
    "@types/react": "$@types/react",
    "@types/react-dom": "$@types/react-dom",
    "@base-ui/react": "$@base-ui/react"
  }
}
